about: Suggestions only: Othos does not call any of these yet. They are free (or free to try) web APIs that fit gardening, books, recipes and movies/TV. Each person decides which to use and gets their own key. Terms were read on Nov 16, 2026; check them again before you use one. Othos's built-in RSS feeds for these topics are separate and need nothing from you (personal.json "topic_feeds" adds or drops feeds).

books.name: Open Library
books.terms: 1 request a second (3 if you identify your app with a User-Agent and email). Cache responses. Not meant as the backend for another service. Data licence: see openlibrary.org/developers/licensing.
books.good_for: who wrote a book, books on a subject

books.name: Google Books
books.key: free key from the Google API Console
books.terms: Its own page says public-data requests need a key. Quota and licence terms are not on that page.
books.good_for: book search by title, author or ISBN

movies_tv.name: TVmaze
movies_tv.terms: 20 calls per 10 seconds per IP. Data is CC BY-SA 4.0: link back to TVmaze. A User-Agent that names your app is recommended.
movies_tv.good_for: TV shows, schedules, when the next episode is on

movies_tv.name: OMDb
movies_tv.terms: Content is CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial). The free daily limit is on its key page.
movies_tv.good_for: movie and series details by title

movies_tv.name: Apple iTunes Search
movies_tv.terms: About 20 calls a minute. Previews may be streamed, not saved. No licence for the data itself is stated.

movies_tv.name: TMDB
movies_tv.terms: Non-commercial only, needs its logo and a notice, no caching longer than 6 months. Its terms forbid use with LLM or chatbot applications, so check them before using it with a voice assistant.
movies_tv.good_for: the largest movie and TV database (see the terms first)

recipes.name: Open Food Facts
recipes.terms: 15 product reads and 10 searches a minute. Always send a User-Agent like AppName/1.0 (your email). Data is ODbL, images CC BY-SA.
recipes.good_for: what is in a packaged food, by barcode

recipes.name: USDA FoodData Central
recipes.terms: 1,000 requests an hour per IP. Public domain (CC0). Keep your key out of public code.

recipes.name: TheMealDB
recipes.key: test key "1" for development and education
recipes.terms: Its page asks you to become a supporter before releasing an app publicly. Rate limits and attribution are in its terms page.

gardening.name: Open-Meteo
gardening.terms: Non-commercial use only (no ads or subscriptions), under 10,000 calls a day, CC BY 4.0.
gardening.good_for: soil temperature and moisture, evapotranspiration for your location

gardening.name: phzmapi (USDA hardiness zone by ZIP)
gardening.terms: No stated limit; please cache. Based on the 2023 map; not the official USDA map. Not every ZIP is covered.

gardening.name: Perenual
gardening.terms: Free-tier limits are on its pricing page. Plant images carry their own licences.
gardening.good_for: plant care facts for thousands of species
